title: Run Actinet Model on Data — actinet
text: file accelerometry file process, including CSV, CWA, GT3X, GENEActiv bin files outdir folder location save output files classifier Enter custom activity classifier file use. Default: walmsley (Walmsley (2020) doi:10.1136/bjsports-2021-104050 annotations activity intensity). Can also enter path local classifier (.joblib.lzma) file. sample_rate Sample rate measurement, otherwise inferred. model_path file path model.  disk, can re-used re-downloaded.  NULL, download temporary directory pytorch_device torch device use, e.g.: 'cpu' 'cuda:0'. Default: 'mps' available, otherwise 'cpu' no_hmm Disable HMM post-processing require_sleep_above Require sleep blocks exceed minimum duration, otherwise classified sedentary. Pass values strings, e.g.: '2H', '30min'. Default: None (requirement) single_sleep_block Recognize one sleep block per day, sleep blocks converted sedentary force_download Force download classifier file exclude_first_last first,last,Exclude first, last days data. Default: None (exclusion) exclude_wear_below Exclude days wear time threshold. Pass values strings, e.g.: '12H', '30min'. Default: None (exclusion) csv_start_row Row number start reading CSV file. Default: 1 (First row) csv_txyz CSV_TXYZ Column names time, x, y, z CSV files. Comma_ separated string. Default: 'time,x,y,z' csv_txyz_idxs Column indices time,x,y,z (0_indexed, e.g., '0,1,2,3'). Overrides csv_txyz. csv_date_format Date time format csv file reading csv file. See https://docs.python.org/3/library/datetime.html#strftime_and_strptime_format_codes possible codes. Default: '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f' (e.g. '2023-10-01 12:34:56.789') calibration_stdtol_min Minimum standard deviation tolerance (g) detecting stationary periods calibration. Default: None plot_activity Plot predicted activity labels cache_classifier Download cache classifier file model modules offline usage verbose print diagnostic messages ... arguments pass actinet pyenv_function function loads forest Python package. default, uses  reticulate::py_import("actinet") import package. function args argument, output pyenv_function re-assigned args. show Logical, whether show standard output screen child process running, passed callr::r()
